headlines.title: Republican-led House rejects Hegseth impeachment effort
headlines.description: The Republican-led House rejected a push to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over how he has carried out the war in Iran and other military hostilities.

headlines.title: House Republicans elect Rep. Jim Jordan as their next leader following election losses
headlines.description: Jim Jordan was elected House Republican leader over Steve Scalise, while John Thune will remain Senate Republican leader, despite a conservative push to delay.

headlines.title: Bernie Sanders says he won’t support Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
headlines.description: Sens. Sanders and Elissa Slotkin called for new leadership, but neither proposed an alternative. Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland is considering challenging Schumer.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. María Elvira Salazar wins re-election in Florida after clashing with Trump
headlines.description: GOP Rep. María Elvira Salazar has won re-election in her Miami-based congressional district, NBC News projects, after clashing with President Donald Trump over his immigration agenda.

headlines.title: Kornacki: How Republicans’ redistricting gamble ended up ‘firing up’ Democrats in North Carolina
headlines.description: Republicans redrew more than a dozen Congressional districts before the midterm elections, yet their efforts seem to have backfired after the Democrats’ sweeping historic wins nationwide. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki breaks down how Democrats in North Carolina won in districts President Trump swept by double digits in 2024.

headlines.title: Sen. Gillibrand ‘optimistic’ on the election of Sen. Schumer as majority leader
headlines.description: Senate Democrats are divided on who should lead their caucus in the next Congress. Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand (D-N.Y.) joins Meet the Press NOW as several new and incumbent senators say they won't support longtime leader Sen. Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.).

headlines.title: Rep. Jim Jordan elected as minority leader as Republicans signal they’re ‘bracing for a fight’
headlines.description: Republicans pick new party leaders after sweeping midterm losses. NBC News’ Sahil Kapur and Monica Alba join Meet the Press NOW to discuss their choices and the brewing battle among Senate Democrats as Sen. Chris Van Hollen (D-Md.) says he’s weighing a challenge to Sen. Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.)

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: House GOP report on Jeffrey Epstein rips Justice Department, urges further investigation
headlines.description: The House Oversight Committee’s review of the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein blasted the Justice Department’s handling of the case from the outset and in the decades since, and called for federal investigators to take a closer look at the late sex offender and his associates.

headlines.title: Hegseth dismisses push to impeach him as a ‘political spectacle’
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a congressional effort to impeach him as a “political spectacle,” as he vowed to fight the charges while defending his management of the war with Iran.

headlines.title: California voters reject new tax on billionaires in a blow to the left
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Proposition 40, which split Democrats in the state and nationally, failed after facing a barrage of attack ads.

headlines.title: Democratic lawmakers seek to restore deportation protections to Afghans in the U.S.
headlines.description: Reps. Jason Crow of Colorado and Sam Liccardo of California plan to file a petition Monday to require a vote on a bill to grant Afghans protection from deportation until mid-2029.
